subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are synchronized, should the security-owned workflow dependency group be approved as one update?
rationale: The defects have a mechanical repair, but the protected security label and CODEOWNERS coverage require an authorized human to accept the grouped privileged-action updates.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Keep the grouped full-SHA updates, require the four assertion fixes and green focused checks, then approve the security-owned workflow changes.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex Action bumps if reviewers want narrower supply-chain review units.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped full-SHA updates, require the four assertion fixes and green focused checks, then approve the security-owned workflow changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent central CI ownership and direct engagement make this the strongest individual routing candidate, while the security CODEOWNERS review remains required.
